name: Suzu
source:
A mysterious girl who gives off a warm feeling.
She seems unreliable in many ways so her senpai(in prostitution, not school) who worry about her suggested she use a false name.
She absolutely loves naughty things but she isn't well versed in a lot so she wants to try various things.
